text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wah, thank you very much!
Thanks to you, our Paka Petit family has grown!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I am your pupil, Trainer! I didn't miss a single one of my master's techniques!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I won't say on the first try, but... three tries...
...N-No, within five tries... I'll definitely get it!
